game_title: Gatekeeper If – Net Menders' Pier Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier, a pier of net menders: the deckhand must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Gatekeeper If: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors.
theme: Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier: a pier of net menders
core_gameplay_loop: In Net Menders' Pier, repeat each round: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors. Each round, a new cargo crates challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the gate_integrity value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 300 points of cargo crates by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 300, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Gatekeeper If
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Gatekeeper If' (Week 3 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Net Menders' Pier'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate_integrity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 300 within 45 seconds.
